hooks.command: entrada=$(cat); case "$entrada" in *'git commit'*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; dir=$(printf '%s' "$entrada" | node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{try{process.stdout.write(JSON.parse(s).cwd||"")}catch(e){}})'); [ -n "$dir" ] && [ -f "$dir/package.json" ] && cd "$dir"; npm test >/tmp/claude-npm-test.log 2>&1 || { echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PreToolUse\",\"permissionDecision\":\"deny\",\"permissionDecisionReason\":\"npm test fallo: no se puede commitear con el sitio roto. Detalle en /tmp/claude-npm-test.log\"}}"; }
hooks.statusMessage: Revisando el sitio antes de commitear...
